1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, __an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said light dispersing optic element includes a phosphor material__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body__.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and a single diode resides on each face__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK.

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current__.

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said light emitting diodes__, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body __and a light dispersing optic element overlapping said light emitting diode__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about __250__ W/mK.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __and said light dispersing optic element includes a phosphor material__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim __17__ wherein said body has substantially straight side walls.
